# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# A COPY OF transfer-do-not-relay.json WITH ONE FIELD CHANGED, selected by `--scenario amount-mismatch`.
# `amount` (and `amounts_by_dest`) is 0.2 XMR where every caller of this fixture asks for 0.1, so the
# one comparison DESIGN.md §2a.2a makes -- the amount the wallet service prepared against the amount the
# user asked for (round 4, S2) -- has a test that can fail. The mock echoes a request's destinations
# back for a bare `transfer` precisely so an ordinary build cannot trip that comparison; a scenario is
# therefore the only way to produce the answer a real wallet-rpc would have to be broken to give.
# Everything else -- tx_hash, tx_metadata, fee, weight -- is byte for byte the original's, because the
# point of the case is the single disagreeing field.
